$comment: Outcome references demonstrate reading order and content choices. They are complete sample pages. Inspect the example closest to the requested artifact. Then use the component registry to compose the supplied content.

items.name: decision-comparison
items.title: Decision comparison
items.job: Choose among meaningfully different approaches and commit to one.
items.boundary: If the reader must change filters or weights, route to an interactive visualization.

items.name: technical-explainer
items.title: Technical explainer
items.job: Build an accurate mental model of a system or change.
items.boundary: If the intended result is durable repository documentation, route to repo-docs.

items.name: status-report
items.title: Status report
items.job: Explain meaningful movement, current constraints, and the next decision.
items.boundary: Do not invent metrics or turn ordinary activity into unnecessary headline measures.

items.name: incident-account
items.title: Incident account
items.job: Explain impact, chronology, cause, response, and prevention.
items.boundary: Keep confirmed facts, inference, and open investigation distinct.

items.name: pr-walkthrough
items.title: PR walkthrough
items.job: Help a reviewer understand the actual work, why it was necessary, its scope, mechanism, and proof.
items.boundary: Ground every claim in the actual diff and repository context.

items.name: implementation-plan
items.title: Plan review
items.job: Understand a proposed change and return explicit decisions, comments, and edited proposals.
items.boundary: Feedback remains local. Recommendations are proposals until explicitly selected.
